mechanism: Tramadol inhibits reuptake of serotonin and norepinephrine while tranylcypromine is an irreversible MAOI, creating a severe risk of serotonin syndrome through additive serotonergic activity.
action: This combination is contraindicated; avoid concurrent use or allow at least 14 days between discontinuation of tranylcypromine and initiation of tramadol, and 5 days between tramadol discontinuation and MAOI initiation.
